opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 in year one, up to £28,000 in years two and three

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For early career researchers with a research record but who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post. Must not have held a full-time permanent academic post in a UK university or non-UK institution, nor may Fellows hold such a post concurrently with the Early Career Fellowship. All candidates must hold a doctorate by the time they take up the Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work. The Trust will contribute 100% of the Fellow’s total salary costs up to a maximum of £56,000 in year one, and 50% of the Fellow’s total salary costs up to a maximum of £28,000 in years two and three. The balance is to be contributed by the host university.
discipline_tags: All disciplines excluding medical and clinical research
